title: Decision Log Entry
description: One entry written by decision-recorder. Entries accumulate at .claude/state/decision-log.md (or an equivalent append-only store) and are never skipped, regardless of a story's context_mode — context_mode governs what a story reads on the way in, never what it writes on the way out.

story_id.description: The story this decision was recorded during, or 'program' if recorded during project-scoper.
